claims.claim: Pentair announced an agreement to acquire Taco Group Holdings for a price described as approximately 10.5x 2026E EBITDA after stated tax benefits and anticipated run-rate cost synergies; Taco is expected to generate about $540M of 2026 revenue and expands Pentair exposure to HVAC and data-center water solutions.
Pentair declared a $0.27 quarterly dividend on September 21, 2026 and states this marks its 50th consecutive year of dividend increases.

risks.risk: Taco acquisition adds integration, leverage/capital-allocation and synergy-realization risk; stated EBITDA multiple depends partly on anticipated benefits.

unknowns.unknown: Post-close integration performance and realized cost synergies are not yet observable.
